text_block_list.text:
One of Hishi Miracle's weaknesses was 
being a slow starter. In order to cover 
for that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Opting for a longer distance for her Debut 
race, she chooses the Kokura 2000m. Amidst 
the pressure, she takes on her first race.
